title: Vehicle Purchase Agreements Balance Due, Late Balance Fee and Returned Payment Schedule
content:
For each deal type of the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements**, this schedule sets the figures for paying a balance due after delivery, for the late balance fee, and for returned payments.

| Deal type | Balance due payable within (calendar days after delivery) | Late balance fee may be assessed after (calendar days after the delivery date) | Late balance fee rate per calendar month assessed | Minimum late balance fee per assessment (USD) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Certified-funds period after a returned payment (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Value Line Used Vehicle Purchase | 0 | 5 | 1.5 percent (0.015) | 25.00 | 30.00 | 90 |
| Used Vehicle Retail Purchase | 5 | 10 | 1.5 percent (0.015) | 25.00 | 30.00 | 90 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Purchase | 5 | 10 | 1.5 percent (0.015) | 25.00 | 30.00 | 90 |
| New Vehicle Retail Purchase | 7 | 12 | 1.5 percent (0.015) | 25.00 | 30.00 | 90 |
| New Vehicle Factory Order Purchase | 7 | 12 | 1.5 percent (0.015) | 25.00 | 30.00 | 90 |
| Fleet Vehicle Purchase Agreement | 30 | 40 | 1.25 percent (0.0125) | 50.00 | 35.00 | 60 |

## Notes
- The assessment figure is the balance-due days plus the grace allowed. Hypothetical: a New Vehicle Retail Purchase delivered on the 2nd of a month has its balance due by the 9th, and a late balance fee may first be assessed on the 15th, the first day after the 14th.
- The late balance fee rate is a fraction of the balance due for each calendar month assessed.
- The returned payment fee applies when a check or ACH payment is returned unpaid. The certified-funds period follows such a return.
